2608.07078.title: Scalable High-Fidelity Macromolecular Docking for GPU-Accelerated Supercomputers
2608.07078.paper_summary: Flexible macromolecular docking offers high-fidelity predictions of biomolecular interactions, but remains prohibitively expensive at scale. Among existing approaches, LightDock leverages Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) for accuracy, yet suffers from limited parallelism, irregular computation, and severe load imbalance, preventing efficient execution on GPU supercomputers. We present SparkleDock, a scalable GSO-based docking framework enabling near-real-time flexible docking. We redesign GSO to expose massive fine-grained parallelism at the glowworm-agent level, and restructure the dominant energy scoring computation into a Tensor Core-compatible formulation, enabling efficient execution of irregular pairwise interactions through structured matrix operations. We further introduce a performance-model-driven scheduling for load balancing and out-of-core scaling across GPUs. SparkleDock achieves 9.7 $\times$ and 18.9 $\times$ speedups over LightDock on single A100 and H100 GPU, and delivers over two orders of magnitude acceleration at scale. On 512 GPUs, it reduces docking time from hours to seconds, enabling large-scale, high-fidelity virtual screening previously impractical with flexible docking.
2608.07078.paper_summary_zh: 靈活的宏觀分子對接提供了生物分子相互作用的高保真預測，但在大規模應用時仍然過於昂貴。在現有的方法中，LightDock 利用螢光蟲群優化（GSO）來提高準確性，但卻受到有限的並行性、不規則計算和嚴重的負載不平衡的影響，這使得在 GPU 超級計算機上無法高效執行。我們提出了 SparkleDock，一個可擴展的基於 GSO 的對接框架，使得近實時的靈活對接成為可能。我們重新設計了 GSO，以在螢光蟲代理層面上暴露出大規模的細粒度並行性，並將主導的能量評分計算重構為與 Tensor Core 兼容的公式，通過結構化矩陣運算實現不規則成對交互的高效執行。我們進一步引入了一種基於性能模型的調度方法，以實現負載平衡和跨 GPU 的外部擴展。SparkleDock 在單個 A100 和 H100 GPU 上分別實現了 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍的加速，並在大規模應用中提供了超過兩個數量級的加速。在 512 個 GPU 上，它將對接時間從幾小時縮短到幾秒，使得以前在靈活對接中不切實際的大規模高保真虛擬篩選成為可能。
